taskDescriptions.name: abil
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: learn all abilities (up to rank #)

taskDescriptions.name: action
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Executes 'sValue' action at X,Y (or triggering actor if unspecified). Uses 'sValue2' as caster if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: actionOnPartyNumActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Executes 'sValue' action on the current landing party actor in slot 'fValue' (starting at 0).

taskDescriptions.name: add50gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Gives 50 gold to the player.

taskDescriptions.name: addgp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Gives 'fValue' gold to the player. If 'sValue' is set, it should be a formula, with the result of that formula being the amount to give.

taskDescriptions.name: addIconToCurrentLocation
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Alias of addIconToLocationID. Use it instead (this is functionally identical, however).

taskDescriptions.name: addItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' num of item 'sValue' ID to X,Y (or sValue2 actor or triggering actor inventory if unspecified). If bValue1, force item to fit.

taskDescriptions.name: addItemToContainer
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' quantity of 'sValue' itemType ID to the first container at X,Y that the item can fit into. If 'sValue2' is specified, that is the itemType ID the container must be. If fValue is 0, it acts as 1.

taskDescriptions.name: addItemToFleetCargo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' quantity of 'sValue' itemType ID to the cargo of the fleet identified by 'sValue2'. sValue2 can be the ID of the commodore of the fleet, or the ID of a ship within the fleet, or the key word 'enemyFleet' or 'assistFleet' for fleets the player is currently in combat with. If fValue is 0, it acts as 1.

taskDescriptions.name: addItemToLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'sValue' as the ID of an itemType or actorType to the stash, cargo or shipwright of a location that has been visited by the player at least once. fValue is the quantity to add, defaulting to 1. If fValue is -2, removes all non-infinite versions of the item before adding an infinite one. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: addJournalGoal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'sValue' as a journal goal to the first available 'goal' gVar, then opens the journal and plays a new goal FX on the goal text. If b1, journal isn't opened and the new goal FX doesn't play.

taskDescriptions.name: addLocationItemToZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds a new locationItem for a location to the current zone, if it is the location's zoneThisLocationIsIn. 'sValue' is the ID of the location and 'sValue2' is the itemType ID to add. X,Y specifies the locationItemOffset to use. If sValue2 is not set, or is blank, a default itemType of port_bighouses3 for ports or location_natural1 for non-ports will be used

taskDescriptions.name: addLocationTag
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the 'sValue' tag to a location's tags list, if it doesn't already exist. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: addLocationUnlockable
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds an unlockable to the current Location of ID sValue, quantity fValue, and fReq sValue2. Use addUnlockableItemToLocationID to add an unlockable to a specific location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: addSpawnDataToLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'sValue' actorPrefab to the auto_spawnDataID list of a location. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: addTalkerToParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to the player's crew. Also adds to the landing party and makes their ID unique if their ID starts with 'hire_'. If b1, adds to the landing party regardless of actor ID.

taskDescriptions.name: addTalkerToParty_temp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to the player's landing party as a temporary party actor. Does not add the actor to the player's crew. Can be removed using the 'removeTempPartyActors' task.

taskDescriptions.name: addToFleet
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to the player's fleet. If the actor is iAmABoat, they are added to the player's fleet ships, otherwise they are added to the player's crew and landing party if there is room.

taskDescriptions.name: addToFleet_andSwapWithFleet_slot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Swaps the ship in slot 'fValue' of the player's fleet with the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog), if they are iAmABoat. Any crew on the swapped out ship will be transferred to the currentActorTalkingTo ship. The swapped out ship actor will try to be placed within the 9 tiles surrounding travel_point9 and be given the 'boat_unmoor' dialogNodeID.

taskDescriptions.name: addToLandingParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the player crew actor with the ID of 'sValue' to the player's landing party if they can fit, and to the current Zone. If b1, don't add them to the current Zone. If b2, adds them to the landing party even if they can't fit.

taskDescriptions.name: addToParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds actor ID 'sValue' to the party.

taskDescriptions.name: addTreasuresToZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds a buried location_shipwreck item, with loot added to it, to the current zone at the X,Y set in gVar 'treasureTCX' and 'treasureTCY'. Fails if the gVars aren't set.

taskDescriptions.name: addTrigger
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds global trigger 'sValue' to the current zone. Only usable if delay is not 0 (otherwise it crashes).

taskDescriptions.name: addUnlockableItemToLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds an itemType or actorType to a location's itemType_quantity_unlockable list with a formula, set in sValue as 'ID, formula'. fValue is the quantity of the unlockable, defaulting to 1, with -2 being infinite. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: addZoneBackgroundTex
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds texture 'sValue' to the list of background textures for the current Zone, if it doesn't already exist.

taskDescriptions.name: addZoneFX
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds a recurring FX 'sValue' to the zone at XY that recurs every 'fValue' indefinitely. If bValue1, then only add FX if it isn't already in the zone.

taskDescriptions.name: adjustFleetAlliegances
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: If the player is in a fleet battle, this turns all actors in the zone that are the same faction as the enemy fleet hostile, clears the playerEscort gVar and plays FX on the changed actors.

taskDescriptions.name: advanceTimers
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Advance all actTimers by fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: allclass
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: unlocks all classes

taskDescriptions.name: allxp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: add # XP in all classes

taskDescriptions.name: anim
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: makes the player perform the specified animation (ex: anim crouch)

taskDescriptions.name: animate
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Animates triggering actor (or actor 'sValue2') with animation 'sValue'. Sets busyTimer to fValue if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: appendToGlobalVar_locID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Appends the ID of the current location to the end of globalVar 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: appendToGlobalVar_math
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Appends the result of Formula 'sValue2' to the end of globalVar 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: appendToGlobalVar_string
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Appends 'sValue2' to the end of globalVar 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: appendToGlobalVar_zoneID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Appends the ID of the current zone to the end of globalVar 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: applyElement
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Applies 'sValue' element at X,Y.

taskDescriptions.name: applyElementToArea
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Applies 'sValue' element to a rectangle starting at XY with width/height set by sValue2 (X,Y). fValue adds an incremental delay between tiles.

taskDescriptions.name: applyElementToZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Applies 'sValue' element to entire zone. If bValue1, also applies to Actors in the zone.

taskDescriptions.name: applyTerrainReplacersAndItemRemovers
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Item and terrain replacer items in the zone are calculated and apply their results. sValue specifies the levelData to use for replacing terrain. If b1, don't update tile sprites.

taskDescriptions.name: askForNewPortName
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Brings up a text entry box for the player to rename the current location.

taskDescriptions.name: attractAttention
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: All actors (within fValue if specified) turn to face X,Y. If bValue1, works on all actors.

taskDescriptions.name: attractAttentionToPlayer
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: All actors (within fValue if specified) turn to face the player. If bValue1, works on all actors.

taskDescriptions.name: autobuy_food
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Forces the player to buy as much food as will fit into their cargo, or that they can afford, whichever is lower.

taskDescriptions.name: autosaveASAP
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Creates an autosave if the player is able to save.

taskDescriptions.name: barracksLineup
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: bezoar_setupportselect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Sets the fast travel dialogOptions the Ruluorn Bezoar uses, for the dialogNode set in strings[0]. floats[0] and floats[1] specify which quadrant to select ports from (-1,-1 specifies northwest, through to 1,1 specifying southeast).

taskDescriptions.name: bighead
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: reveals the true self

taskDescriptions.name: boardActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: sValue = target to board. sValue2 = boarder

taskDescriptions.name: breakAllStashItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets broken = true for every item in the player's stash inventory that can be broken.

taskDescriptions.name: build
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: force build mode (such as during combat)

taskDescriptions.name: buryAllItemsOfType
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: buries all items of type sValue. if bValue1, unburies them. sValue2 = itemType.specialProperty to (un)bury, if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: buryGlobalVarItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: buries or unburies items that convert to globals, depending on if their globalVar is set.

taskDescriptions.name: buryLocations
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: buries undiscovered locations.

taskDescriptions.name: buyFood
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' food to the player's cargo, if they can afford it, and subtracts the cost from their gold.

taskDescriptions.name: buyFood_fillCargo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds as much food as the player can hold to their cargo, if they can afford it, and subtracts the cost from their gold.

taskDescriptions.name: buyGoods
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' of the current location's tradeGood_itemTypeID to the player's cargo, if they can afford it, and subtracts the cost from their gold.

taskDescriptions.name: buyGoods_confirmWindow
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: buyItem_confirmWindow
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: buyLocationFood
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Goes through the process of buying and applying the effects of the current location's cafeFood_itemTypeID to the player's crew.

taskDescriptions.name: buyShip
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the ship actor with the ID of 'sValue' to the player's fleet and subtracts the cost of it from their gold.

taskDescriptions.name: bz
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: show list of all saved zones that start with 'bz'.

taskDescriptions.name: calc
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: prints result of specified formula (ex: calc c:PhysAtk)

taskDescriptions.name: cameraAtPlayer
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Points the camera at the tile the current player actor is on.

taskDescriptions.name: cameraAtPoint
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Points the camera at travel point #floats[0], set floats[1].

taskDescriptions.name: cameraAtPointLock
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Points the camera at travel point #floats[0], set floats[1], and locks it there until the camera is pointed at something else with the 'pointCameraAt' task.

taskDescriptions.name: cameraAtTalker
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Points the camera at the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: cancelIf
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Cancels further effects if sValue calculates true (> 0). If bValue, cancels when sValue calcs as false (less or = 0)

taskDescriptions.name: cancelIfEnemiesNotPresent
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Cancels further effects if no non-incapped hostiles are within 'fValue' of triggering actor or X,Y. If fValue=0, distance is infinite.

taskDescriptions.name: cancelIfEnemiesPresent
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Cancels further effects if any non-incapped hostiles are within 'fValue' of triggering actor or X,Y. If fValue=0, distance is infinite. If sValue1 specified, only checks actors with that actorTypeID.

taskDescriptions.name: cancelIfItemNotPresent
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Cancels further effects if item 'sValue' is not found at X,Y. If X = -1, checks trigger area for the item.

taskDescriptions.name: cancelIfItemPresent
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Cancels further effects if item 'sValue' is found at X,Y. If X = -1, checks trigger area for the item.

taskDescriptions.name: cancelQuest
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets all quest-related globalVars and hides all overworld locations with a 'monsterden' tag.

taskDescriptions.name: cancelRoyalQuest
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets all quest-related globalVars and hides all overworld locations with a 'monsterden' tag, if globalVar 'questRoyal' is > 0.

taskDescriptions.name: captureShipNum
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Adds the ship actor in slot 'fValue' of the ships captured during fleet combat to the player's fleet, if there are any available slots.

taskDescriptions.name: captureShips_afterCombat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets up the dialogOptions for the 'sValue' dialogNode with all the ships captured during fleet combat.

taskDescriptions.name: cartographer_report
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the 'sValue' dialogNode to be used with a cartographer's report. Also sets the 'mapPercentPaid globalVar to the currently explored overworld percentage.

taskDescriptions.name: changeCafeFood
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes a location's cafeFood_itemTypeID to 'sValue'. If sValue is the ID of another location, it will use the cafeFood_itemTypeID of that location instead and also change the location's auto_spawnDataID to match it. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location to change. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: changeFaction
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes all actors of 'sValue' faction to 'sValue2' faction.

taskDescriptions.name: changePlayerActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes the current player party leader to actor ID 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: changeScreenResolution2
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: changeTradeGood
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes a location's tradeGood_itemTypeID to 'sValue'. If sValue is the ID of another location, it will use the tradeGood_itemTypeID of that location instead. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location to change. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: changeZoneDarkColor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes zone darkness color to sValue (given as 'R, G, B'). If bValue1, sets color immediately instead of easing.

taskDescriptions.name: cleanUpQuest
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets all quest-related globalVars and hides all overworld locations with a 'monsterden' tag.

taskDescriptions.name: clear
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Clears all text from the console window.

taskDescriptions.name: clearactors
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes all non-party actors from the current zone. If sValue is set, it should be an fReq that will get checked for each actor.

taskDescriptions.name: clearDialogNode
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Clears the dialogNode of the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: clearfog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: sets entire zone's fog of war to known

taskDescriptions.name: clearGlobalVar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the globalVar 'sValue' from the list of globalVars.

taskDescriptions.name: clearjournal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: remove all journal entries

taskDescriptions.name: clearLocationItemsFromZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes all of a location's set locationItems from the zone, if the current zone is the location's zoneThisLocationIsIn. 'sValue' is the ID of the location. If 'sValue2' is set, it should be the ID of an itemType that will be the new locationItem, placed at offset 0,0.

taskDescriptions.name: clearPartyPath
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Makes party actors temporarily able to move freely, without following the currently selected party leader.

taskDescriptions.name: clearroofs
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: removes all roof items

taskDescriptions.name: closeCharEdit
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Closes the actor name/appearance editor window, if it is open.

taskDescriptions.name: closeFleetWindow
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Closes the fleet information window, if it is open and the player isn't holding an actor.

taskDescriptions.name: closeJournal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Closes the journal window, if it is open.

taskDescriptions.name: completeJournalGoal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Completes the journal goal found with the same text as set in 'sValue'. This will open the journal, put a line through the goal, play FX and award 50 XP to all player crew. If b1, hides all interactive buttons (used for credits). If b2, doesn't give XP, open journal or play completion FX. The journal goal gVars will be stripped of spaces and special chars when checked against sValue. The check will be done in a case-insensitive manner.

taskDescriptions.name: consolecommand
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Executes consolecommand sValue.

taskDescriptions.name: convertPlayerPortsToFaction
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets all ports with a 'sport' tag (usually player established) to be ever-loyal to faction ID 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: convertRGB
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: loads (param).png from desktop and palettizes it (removes excess RGB so all pixels are only R, G, or B) then saves to desktop

taskDescriptions.name: crash
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Crashes the game with a missing dictionary index error.

taskDescriptions.name: createMonsterDenNearby
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up an overworld monster den that is closest to the current location using levelData 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: createTreasureMap
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Creates the texture 'treasureMap' for use with salvage quests. The texture is created for overworld X,Y set in floats[0], floats[1].

taskDescriptions.name: createZoneSpecialFX
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Creates FX based on zone_tintMap, or if bValue1, deepWater. sValue = pattern texture override. XY * 0.1 = veloc. fValue = -alpha offset. If bValue2, saves textures to the desktop.

taskDescriptions.name: crewMorale
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Increases (or decreases) player crew morale by fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: crewxp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Gives 'fValue' XP to all of the player's crew members.

taskDescriptions.name: csave
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Forces a save to be made named 'sValue', or 'consoleSave' if not specified.

taskDescriptions.name: cutsceneMode
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: cutsceneMode allows actors to keep moving/etc regardless of turn. If bValue1, cutsceneMode = true. Otherwise false.

taskDescriptions.name: damageNumber
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Displays 'sValue' text above actor 'sValue2's head for 2 + fValue seconds. If sValue2 is blank, uses current player actor. Can set text color using 'actorID,color'. If X,Y is set, displays the text at that TC instead. If b1, text doesn't bounce. If b2, 'sValue' should be a gVar and its value is used as the text instead.

taskDescriptions.name: damageNumber_worldTime
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Displays the current time above actor 'sValue's head for 2 + fValue seconds. If sValue is blank, uses current player actor. Can set text color in sValue2. If X,Y is set, displays the text at that TC instead. If b1, text doesn't bounce.

taskDescriptions.name: debug
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Toggles debugMode on/off.

taskDescriptions.name: debug_drawStrings
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Displays a debug message using 'sValue' as the type and 'sValue2' as the message.

taskDescriptions.name: debugMessage
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Displays a debug message using 'sValue' as the type and 'sValue2' as the message.

taskDescriptions.name: delayActions
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Disables actors and actions for fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: delayDialog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: If in dialog mode, delays showing the current dialogNode for fValue seconds.

taskDescriptions.name: deleteZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: permanently deletes original zone data. Do not use.

taskDescriptions.name: destination
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets destination of actor of ID 'sValue' (or triggerActor if unspecifed) to X,Y. fValue permanently sets movementSpeed if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: dialogEffect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Executes strings[0] as a dialog specialEffect string after a delay of floats[1] seconds.

taskDescriptions.name: die
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Kills the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog), even if they have unkillable set.

taskDescriptions.name: disableFog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Disables fog for this zone.

taskDescriptions.name: disableHelpGem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Disables use of the Help Gem.

taskDescriptions.name: disableTrigger
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Disables trigger of IDnum fValue or alias sValue.

taskDescriptions.name: disableUI
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Hides the quickslots and character stats windows. Show them again with 'enableUI' task.

taskDescriptions.name: discoverFog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Reveals a small fogOfWar area at X,Y.

taskDescriptions.name: dominateworld
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets wealth to 100 for all overworld ports and converts them to the player's current faction.

taskDescriptions.name: donate
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Acts as if the player had donated 'fValue' gold to the current location, which increases its favor and gives trade fame.

taskDescriptions.name: dropItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Drops item 'sValue2' from actor 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: editmod
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Uploads mod changes for the mod currently being edited, using mod folder 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: editmodtags
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Changes the tags for the mod currently being edited to each strings[] set.

taskDescriptions.name: enableHelpGem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Enables use of the Help Gem (if recharged).

taskDescriptions.name: enableTrigger
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Re-enables trigger of IDnum fValue or alias sValue.

taskDescriptions.name: enableUI
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Shows the quickslots and character stats windows if they had been previously hidden with 'disableUI'.

taskDescriptions.name: endBoarding
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: calls ZoneManager.I.returnFromBoardingZone()

taskDescriptions.name: endGame
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sends the player to the main menu.

taskDescriptions.name: enemyFlee
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: All actors in the combat area that are the same faction as the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) are removed from the zone, then the playerParty is awarded XP.

taskDescriptions.name: enemyInitiateCombat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Causes the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to initiate combat with the player.

taskDescriptions.name: enemyMoraleDown
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Lowers the morale by 1 stage for actors within the combat area that are the same faction as the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: enemyMoraleUp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Increases the morale by 1 stage for actors within the combat area that are the same faction as the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: enterBuyMode
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enters buy/sell mode with the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: enterBuyMode_fleet
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enters buy/sell mode with the fleet currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) belongs to.

taskDescriptions.name: enterBuyMode_location
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enters buy/sell mode for the current location's cargo inventory.

taskDescriptions.name: enterBuyMode_locationItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enters buy/sell mode for the current location's stash inventory.

taskDescriptions.name: enterCombat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enter combat at X,Y with radius 'fValue' (or default radius if unspecified). 'sValue' is which actor intiated combat, if any.

taskDescriptions.name: enterCombat_timer
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enters combat at X,Y, with a radius of 999 and sets action 'sValue' to be executed at X,Y after 'fValue' actTime.

taskDescriptions.name: enterFleetBattle
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: sets gVars playerX & playerY to player pos. Enters new fleetBattle zone, bringing Player, sValue, and sValue2 Actors' fleets with them. Puts fleets on travel_point A,B,C respectively.

taskDescriptions.name: enterFleetBattle_player
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: sets gVars playerX & playerY to player pos. Enters new fleetBattle zone, bringing Player, sValue, and sValue2 Actors' fleets with them. Puts fleets on travel_point A,B,C respectively. Sets the fleet battle as having been initiated by the player.

taskDescriptions.name: enterLocation
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Forces the player to enter the closest non-port location that is in the current zone, within 4 tiles of them.

taskDescriptions.name: enterPort
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Forces the player to enter the closest port location that is in the current zone, within 4 tiles of them.

taskDescriptions.name: enterSellMode
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Opens player actor inventories and sets tradeMode=true.

taskDescriptions.name: enterSellMode_cargo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Opens player cargo inventory and sets tradeMode=true.

taskDescriptions.name: enterSellMode_stash
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Opens player stash inventory and sets tradeMode=true.

taskDescriptions.name: errors
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Toggles crash error reporting on/off.

taskDescriptions.name: escapeGate
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Executes action 'escapeGate_act' on the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog), which removes them from the zone.

taskDescriptions.name: executeActionMovement
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Executes actor-movement and actor-swap effects for the action strings[0] using tileCoords[] as the targeted tiles.

taskDescriptions.name: executeDialogEffect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Executes special dialog effect 'sValue', using 'sValue2' dialogNode (optional), and passing in fValue (optional).

taskDescriptions.name: exitCombat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Exits combat

taskDescriptions.name: exitDialog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Exits dialog mode.

taskDescriptions.name: facingRot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets triggering actor (or actor 'sValue' if specified) to fValue rot.

taskDescriptions.name: facingRot0
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 0 facingRot.

taskDescriptions.name: facingRot180
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 180 facingRot.

taskDescriptions.name: facingRot270
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 270 facingRot.

taskDescriptions.name: facingRot90
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 90 facingRot.

taskDescriptions.name: facingRotParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets party actors to fValue rot.

taskDescriptions.name: facingRotPrev
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to talkerPreviousFacingRot rot.

taskDescriptions.name: filljournal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: add all journal entries

taskDescriptions.name: flee
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: The currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) is removed from the zone.

taskDescriptions.name: forget
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: clears saved memory of specified zone.

taskDescriptions.name: formulas
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: lists out all globalFormulas

taskDescriptions.name: fullheal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Fully heals playerParty, including HPMax lost from being KO'd.

taskDescriptions.name: fullrestore
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Fully heals playerParty, including HPMax lost from being KO'd.

taskDescriptions.name: fx
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Plays fx 'sValue' at X,Y. 'sValue2' uses that actor's position instead. If nothing specified, plays fx at camera position. If b1, X,Y is screen position. If used in a task, string 3 sets fx color and a second TC specifies fx target.

taskDescriptions.name: fxOnParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Plays fx 'sValue' at the X,Y of each partyActor.

taskDescriptions.name: fxOnPlayerRank
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Plays fx 'sValue' at the screen position where the player's rank is on the escMenu.

taskDescriptions.name: fxOnTalker
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Plays fx 'sValue' at the X,Y of the currentActorTalkingTo.

taskDescriptions.name: gameOver
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Ends the game for the player and returns them to the main menu. If the zone has cantGameOver=true, reacts all triggers in the zone with Element.gameOver.

taskDescriptions.name: gc
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Forces program garbage collection.

taskDescriptions.name: get
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: prints value of global variable - or prints flagged triggers of given zoneName (ex: get zTown1)

taskDescriptions.name: getBribeAmount
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets the currentDialogNode's statements[0] to reflect a bribe amount used for auto dialog.

taskDescriptions.name: getItemsFromZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: removes all items that can be picked up from sValue zone and places them at XY

taskDescriptions.name: getmod
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets mod ID 'sValue' as the mod currently being edited, for use with other mod tasks.

taskDescriptions.name: getResponse_bribe
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets the currentDialogNode's nextNodeID to the response for being bribed. Used in auto dialog.

taskDescriptions.name: getResponse_combat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets the currentDialogNode's nextNodeID to the response for combat. Used in auto dialog.

taskDescriptions.name: getResponse_peace
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets the currentDialogNode's nextNodeID to the response for wanting peace. Used in auto dialog.

taskDescriptions.name: giveActorsBaseXP
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Awards between 54 and 84 XP in all classes to every actor in the zone, if they have less than 54 XP.

taskDescriptions.name: giveFood
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' food to the player's cargo, if it can fit.

taskDescriptions.name: giveGlobalVarGP
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the value set in 'sValue' globalVar of gold to the player.

taskDescriptions.name: giveItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' quantity of item ID 'sValue' to the player's cargo or stash inventory, depending on the item. If can't fit, added to held items. fValue 0 gives 1, -1 is default quantity, -2 is infinite, -11 through -19 is % chance to keep.

taskDescriptions.name: giveMathXPToActorWithDialogNodeID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Gives formula 'sValue2' amount of XP to every actor in the current zone with 'sValue' dialogNodeID. Won't exceed player's total XP.

taskDescriptions.name: giveQuestItemReward
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Gives gold equal to the value of the item ID set in globalVar 'tavern_questItem'.

taskDescriptions.name: giveShip
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds ship actorType ID 'sValue' to the player's fleet, if it can fit. Uses ID 'sValue2' for the ship actor if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: go
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: transitions to specified zone (ex: go zoneName)

taskDescriptions.name: gob
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: transitions to specified zone and enters build mode (ex: gob zoneName)

taskDescriptions.name: godmode
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Maxes out the player's HP/MP and other stats and learns all actions from every selectable class.

taskDescriptions.name: gotoNodeDelay
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Tries to go to dialogNode 'sValue' after 'fValue' seconds. Uses the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) as the talker.

taskDescriptions.name: goToNodeID_plus_GlobalVar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used in dialog. Tries to go to the dialogNode with the ID of the current dialogNode, plus the string set in the globalVar with the same ID as the dialogNode ID.

taskDescriptions.name: gotoNodeIf
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used in dialog. Tries to go to dialogNode 'sValue' if formula 'sValue2' passes.

taskDescriptions.name: gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: adds # GP (or gives 500 if unspecified)

taskDescriptions.name: grantXPShare_5percent
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Gives 5% of each class's XP globalVar to every current partyActor if globalVar 'XPShare' is set to 1.

taskDescriptions.name: handleDeaths
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Updates 'dying' and 'dead' AVs for each actor in the current zone.

taskDescriptions.name: handleTiredStates
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Makes party tired, and makes barracks actors rested.

taskDescriptions.name: heal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Heals triggering actor, or actor 'sValue', by fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: healfaction
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Heals all actors in the current zone with the faction 'sValue'. Does not restore HPMax lost from being KO'd.

taskDescriptions.name: healparty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Heals playerParty, without restoring HPMax lost from being KO'd.

taskDescriptions.name: help
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: prints a description of the command (ex: help revive)

taskDescriptions.name: hideEscWindows
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Hides all windows used for the escMenu.

taskDescriptions.name: hidemapicons
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: If the player is currently in the overworld zone, sets all locations to discovered = false.

taskDescriptions.name: hideparty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: hides the party forever

taskDescriptions.name: hideParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Turns party invisible for 'fValue' time.

taskDescriptions.name: hideQuickslots
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Hides character stats and quickslots window.

taskDescriptions.name: hostile
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the current task actor to hostile = true.

taskDescriptions.name: howmany
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Displays a debug message with how many items are in the current zone. Only counts items with ID 'sValue' if set.

taskDescriptions.name: howmanyitems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: counts items in the zone. Counts all items if ID not specified.

taskDescriptions.name: howmanyWorld
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Displays a debug message with how many times 'sValue' appears in each zone file in the ZoneData folder. If mouse is pointing at an item or actor, checks for that ID.

taskDescriptions.name: incDefaultNode
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Increases the number at the end of the dialogNodeID of the task actor by 1.

taskDescriptions.name: incOnNewDay
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Increases the number at the end of the dialogNodeID of the task actor by 1 if at least 1 day has passed since this task was called for the task actor.

taskDescriptions.name: initWaypoints
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: refreshes waypoint data of the current zone

taskDescriptions.name: invest
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Acts as if the player had invested 'fValue' gold into the current location.

taskDescriptions.name: investigator_fleetpos
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the currentActorTalkingTo investigator's response and task to perform for when tracking faction ID 'sValue's fleets.

taskDescriptions.name: investigator_nearestLoc
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the currentActorTalkingTo investigator's response for when finding the nearest undiscovered location.

taskDescriptions.name: investigator_setupfleetposselect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the dialogNode ID 'sValue' dialogOptions for selecting which faction's fleets to track for use with an investigator.

taskDescriptions.name: investigator_setupportselect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Sets the port selection dialogOptions the investigator uses for investment information, for the dialogNode set in strings[0]. floats[0] and floats[1] specify which quadrant to select ports from (-1,-1 specifies northwest, through to 1,1 specifying southeast).

taskDescriptions.name: investigator_slainenemy
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the currentActorTalkingTo investigator's response and task to perform for when checking for unexamined monsters.

taskDescriptions.name: investigator_tradespecial
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the currentActorTalkingTo investigator's response for when finding out next month's trade special.

taskDescriptions.name: jobDialogOptions
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the dialogNode ID 'sValue' dialogOptions for the current location's set questTypes.

taskDescriptions.name: k
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: show kills

taskDescriptions.name: kill
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: kill everything but the party

taskDescriptions.name: killall
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Incaps all non-controllable actors in the zone that don't have the 'invincible' AV.

taskDescriptions.name: killcrew
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: kill all crew on non-player ships

taskDescriptions.name: killFaction
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Incaps all actors of 'sValue' faction.

taskDescriptions.name: learnJournalEntry
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the journalEntry ID in sValue to the known journals list. If b1, play a sound. If b2, don't open journal to show the entry.

taskDescriptions.name: learnJournalEntry_silent
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the journalEntry ID in sValue to the known journals list without opening the journal or playing any FX. If b1, also adds it to the reported journals list without giving any reward.

taskDescriptions.name: listav
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: lists all ActorValues. (scroll using mousewheel) Specify an ActorValue to view its data.

taskDescriptions.name: listfx
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: lists all FX. (scroll using mousewheel) Specify an FX to view its data.

taskDescriptions.name: loadItOnUpYo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Moves the player to zone strings[0] at position tileCoords[0], facing floats[0] with floats[1] as the fadeSpeed.

taskDescriptions.name: loadModPageInBrowser
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Opens the modding reference guide URL (located on Steam) in the player's default browser.

taskDescriptions.name: loads
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: loadSpecialZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Loads in zone 'sValue' as a non-interactive overlay at X,Y. fValue = depthMod. sValue2 = scale, if specified (default to 1). If bValue1, only draws zone if roofs are drawn.

taskDescriptions.name: loadSpecialZone_playerFlagship
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: As 'loadSpecialZone', but disregards 'sValue' and loads the player's flagship bz instead.

taskDescriptions.name: loadSpecialZone_playerFlagship_precision
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Same as 'loadSpecialZone_playerFlagship' task, but X,Y is divided by 100 to get a precise tile position.

taskDescriptions.name: loadSpecialZone_precision
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Same as 'loadSpecialZone' task, but X,Y is divided by 100 to get a precise tile position.

taskDescriptions.name: location_tryUnlockItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Checks for any unlockable items in the current location and displays a message if anything was unlocked.

taskDescriptions.name: lockCameraAt
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Points camera at X,Y, or actor.ID if X,Y is unspecified. fValue alters speed if specified. Locks camera indefinitely. If bValue1, camera goes under roofs.

taskDescriptions.name: lookAtPlayer
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Makes the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) look in the direction of the current player actor.

taskDescriptions.name: lookAtTalker
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Makes the player look at the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: lootFleet_afterCombat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Opens the enemyFleet cargo inventory so the player can loot it.

taskDescriptions.name: lose10Food
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 10 food from the player's cargo inventory.

taskDescriptions.name: markDojoLocDone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes the 'sign_icon_muscle' icon to 'sign_icon_muscle_done' in the current location's tooltipIcons, if it exists.

taskDescriptions.name: markTrainerLocDone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes the 'sign_icon_book' or 'sign_icon_2book' icon to its '_done' or '_done_done' version in the current location's tooltipIcons, if they exist.

taskDescriptions.name: maximizeWindowIfTrue
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Maximizes the game window if bValue1 is true.

taskDescriptions.name: maximizeWindowSet
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Maximizes the game window if bValue1 is true.

taskDescriptions.name: mergeSpecialZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Overwrites area with specialZone (excluding transparent/BG terrain). Sets specialZone at X,Y if specified. If b1, doesn't overwrite existing items.

taskDescriptions.name: modFame
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' to globalVar 'fame_' + 'sValue', displays its associated icon and plays a sound.

taskDescriptions.name: modGlobalVar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' to globalVar 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: modLocationIDFactionIDFavor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' faction_favor for 'sValue' faction ID to a port location. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If b1, resets every faction's favor to 0 before adding fValue to sValue (will unset ever-loyal ports). If b2, sets the port to be ever-loyal to sValue faction instead.

taskDescriptions.name: modLocFavor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' to the player's 'favor_' faction globalVar for the current location's favored faction. Also shows associated favor icons and sounds.

taskDescriptions.name: modLocWealthLevel
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' to the current location's wealthLevel, which won't go below 0 or above 100. If sValue is set, adds to that location's wealthLevel instead.

taskDescriptions.name: modNodeIDGlobalVar_1
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used in dialog. Adds 1 to the globalVar with the same ID as the currentDialogNodeID.

taskDescriptions.name: modNodeIDGlobalVar_999
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used in dialog. Adds 999 to the globalVar with the same ID as the currentDialogNodeID.

taskDescriptions.name: modPlayerFactionFavor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' or the result of the formula set in sValue to the player's 'favor_' + 'playerFaction' globalVar, if the 'playerFaction' gVar is set.

taskDescriptions.name: modTalkerFactionFavor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used in dialog. Adds 'fValue' to the player's 'favor_' faction ID globalVar matching the currentActorTalkingTo's set faction.

taskDescriptions.name: modTalkerFavor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' to the player's 'favor_' faction ID globalVar matching the currentActorTalkingTo's set faction (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: moveActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves actor 'sValue' to X,Y and sets facingRot to 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: moveActor_point
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves actor 'sValue' to #X, set Y (A=0, B=1...) travel point.

taskDescriptions.name: moveAllActorsBy
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves all actors and camera by X,Y. If fValue != 0, sets actors' facingRot to fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: moveCamXY
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Adds floats[0], floats[1] to the camera's current X,Y position.

taskDescriptions.name: moveItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves items from topLeft of trigger area to X,Y.

taskDescriptions.name: moveItemsToActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves items from X,Y to actor 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: moveJournal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves the journalWindow to screen position X,Y at speed 'fValue'. If b1, X position is offset from screen center. If b2, moves journalWindow to screen center.

taskDescriptions.name: movement
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets movement of actor of ID 'sValue' (or triggerActor if unspecifed) to go to X,Y. (If X or Y are unspecified, only moves along the specified axis.) If bValue1, actor uses pain animation. fValue permanently sets movementSpeed if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: movePartyBy
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves entire party and camera by X,Y. If fValue != 0, sets actors' facingRot to fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: movePartyTo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves entire party and camera by X,Y - triggerActor.position. If fValue != 0, sets actors' facingRot to fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: movePartyTo_point
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves entire party and camera to travel point #X, set Y (A=0, B=1...) If bValue1, doesn't use X - just puts party on the set. If b2, brings out boats from player fleet.

taskDescriptions.name: moveSpecialZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves specialZone to X,Y at fValue speed. Eases if bValue1.

taskDescriptions.name: moveSpecialZone_precision
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Same as 'moveSpecialZone' task, but X,Y is divided by 100 to get a precise tile position.

taskDescriptions.name: moveToNewZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Cutscene & scripting use. Transfers party to 'sValue' zone at X,Y. fValue, if specified, sets the fade to black speed.

taskDescriptions.name: moveX1
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to the right 1 tile, with no restrictions.

taskDescriptions.name: moveXNeg1
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to the left 1 tile, with no restrictions.

taskDescriptions.name: moveXY
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Moves the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) by floats[0] X and floats[1] Y, with no restrictions.

taskDescriptions.name: moveY1
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) down 1 tile, with no restrictions.

taskDescriptions.name: moveYNeg1
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) up 1 tile, with no restrictions.

taskDescriptions.name: mpos
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggle show mouse screen (not world) coordinates.

taskDescriptions.name: nextDialogNode_hideWindow
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets nextDialogNode_hideWindow to true, which hides the next dialog window.

taskDescriptions.name: noSpeechFXLookOrAnim
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a dialog specialEffect. The current dialogNode won't show its text reveal FX or play any set animations. The currentActorTalkingTo also won't look at the player.

taskDescriptions.name: offerRest
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Opens dialog box allowing player to rest and heal party, if nothing threatening is nearby.

taskDescriptions.name: openCargo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Shows the player's cargo inventory window.

taskDescriptions.name: openFleetWindow
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Shows the player's fleet information window.

taskDescriptions.name: openFleetWindow_delay
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Shows the player's fleet information window after a 0.1s delay.

taskDescriptions.name: openFleetWindow_talker
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Shows the fleet information window for the fleet the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) is part of.

taskDescriptions.name: openJournal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Opens the journal and flips to entry number 'fValue'. If b1, hides the journal's arrows and close buttons.

taskDescriptions.name: openJournal_interactive
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Opens the journal and flips to entry number 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: overseer
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Forces overseerMode on.

taskDescriptions.name: p
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Creates an example procedurally generated zone using 'sValue' levelData, then transfers the player to it at TC 10,10. If b1, acts as if entering via console.

taskDescriptions.name: path
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets path of actor of ID 'sValue' (or triggerActor if unspecifed) to X,Y. If bValue is true, uses waypoints. fValue permanently sets movementSpeed if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: pathParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets path of all party actors to X,Y.

taskDescriptions.name: peace
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Ends combat with any actors within the combat area that have the same faction as the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog), sets their hostile to false and awards the playerParty with XP.

taskDescriptions.name: peaceXPrewardOnly
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Gives the XP to the playerParty that would be rewarded with the 'peace' task, but doesn't change any actors.

taskDescriptions.name: placeActorFromBoardedShip
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Places actors from currently boarded ship of actorType string0 at travelpoint specified by XY (point# X, set# Y)

taskDescriptions.name: playerAnim
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Makes the current player actor play animation 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: playerFacingRot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the current player actor's facingRot to 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: playerFlee
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Ends combat with any actors within the combat area that have the same faction as the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog), then gives 'invisible' AV to playerParty.

taskDescriptions.name: playerInitiateCombat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Causes the player to initiate combat with the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: playerMoraleUp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Increases the morale stage by 1 for all partyActors.

taskDescriptions.name: playNearestLocationSong
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Plays the externalSong of the location in the current zone that is closest to the player.

taskDescriptions.name: playSong
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Plays 'sValue' song at 'fValue' pitch. If sValue = 'travelSong' or 'combatSong', uses Zone defaults instead. If X is set, volume = X/100. If Y set, delay = Y. bValue1 prevents the song from being changed to travelSong. To stop music immediately, set volume to 0. If bValue2, song starts at full volume instead of fading in.

taskDescriptions.name: pointCameraAt
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Points camera at X,Y, or actor.ID if X,Y is unspecified. fValue alters speed if specified. bValue1 sets cameraCantBeChangedTimer to delay_preventInteraction. If bValue2, camera goes under roofs.

taskDescriptions.name: preventInteraction
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Disables player input for fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: quietsave
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Saves to Globals.AUTOSAVE_NAME, with no notification.

taskDescriptions.name: rankstyle
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Toggles class action rank's notch style on/off. Does not get saved.

taskDescriptions.name: reactOnMatchingItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Finds all 'sValue' items in the zone that are adjacent & facing eachother, and applies Element.matched. If sValue2 is specified, matches sValue & sValue2 items.

taskDescriptions.name: readdVendorToParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds the actor on travelPoint 'fValue' to the player's party if their dialogNodeID equals 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: realtime
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles realtime mode (probably very buggy)

taskDescriptions.name: reassignQuestItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets globalVar 'tavern_questItem' to a random ID from the 'loot_quest' item's toMake list.

taskDescriptions.name: recoverOverboardPartyActors
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes any dead ship actors from the player's fleet and moves their crew to the flagship.

taskDescriptions.name: refreshloc
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Loads any missing locations and adds their locationItems to the zoneThisLocationIsIn.

taskDescriptions.name: refreshLocQuests
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Randomizes the available questTypes for the current location, if it is a port and has 'sign_icon_letter' in its tooltipIcons.

taskDescriptions.name: refreshRoyalQuests
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Randomizes the current royal quest, if one isn't already set.

taskDescriptions.name: refreshRoyalTitle
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar 'playerTitle' to an empty string.

taskDescriptions.name: refreshStatModifiers
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets all enemy stat multipliers, player stat modifiers, boat mods and day bonuses for every actor in the current zone.

taskDescriptions.name: refreshStatMods
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets all enemy stat multipliers, player stat modifiers, boat mods and day bonuses for every actor in the current zone.

taskDescriptions.name: refreshUndamagedShipZones
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Deletes all saved boat zones from the current save file for every ship actor in the player's fleet.

taskDescriptions.name: relocateActors
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Puts all actors within fValue of XY to the nearest occupiable tile within fValue+3. If b1, animate pain. If sValue1 specified, move only actors of that faction.

taskDescriptions.name: relocateActors_point
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Puts all actors within fValue of XY onto travel point set # sValue2. If sValue1 specified, move only actors of that faction. If b1, only use unoccupied tiles. If b2, randomize tiles.

taskDescriptions.name: removeActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes actor 'sValue', or actor at X,Y if specified. If bValue1, adds actor_flee fx. If bValue2, puts their items in your stash.

taskDescriptions.name: removeActorItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes item 'sValue2' from actor 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: removeActors_despawnable
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Remove all actors with canDespawn=true. If bValue1, adds actor_flee fx. If bValue2, only affects incapped actors.

taskDescriptions.name: removeActorType
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Remove all actors of type 'sValue'. If bValue1, adds actor_flee fx.

taskDescriptions.name: removeAllItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Deletes 'sValue' item from zone. Uses gVar if 'sValue2' specified. Can also remove all at XY if no sValue given.

taskDescriptions.name: removeAllItemsOfValue
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Deletes items from zone of value fValue or greater.

taskDescriptions.name: removeCargo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 'fValue' quantity of item ID 'sValue' from the player's cargo inventory.

taskDescriptions.name: removeCargo_g
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 'fValue' quantity of the item ID set in globalVar 'sValue' from the player's cargo inventory.

taskDescriptions.name: removeEmptyItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes all containers from the current zone that have the ID of 'sValue' and have no items inside of them.

taskDescriptions.name: removeExcessLandingPartyActors
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes any actors from the player's partyActors that aren't in their landingParty.

taskDescriptions.name: removeFaction
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes all actors of 'sValue' faction.

taskDescriptions.name: removeFromFleet_slot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the ship actor in slot 'fValue' of the player's fleet and places it around travelPoint 9 in the current zone, if it can fit.

taskDescriptions.name: removeFromLandingParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the player crew actor with the ID of 'sValue' from the player's landing party, if they are currently in it, and the current Zone. If b1, don't remove them from the current Zone.

taskDescriptions.name: removeFromParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes actor ID 'sValue' from the party. If bValue1, removes from fleet as well (if applicable).

taskDescriptions.name: removeFromParty_slot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the actor in slot 'fValue' of the player's current partyActors and adds them to the first unoccupied travelPoint set D item. Also changes their dialogNodeID to 'crew_rehire'.

taskDescriptions.name: removeHeldItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Deletes all held items.

taskDescriptions.name: removeIconFromLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 'sValue' icon from a location's tooltipIcons list, if it exists. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: removeItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Deletes 'sValue' item at X,Y. If unspecified, removes 'fValue' num of the item from triggering actor's inventory. if sValue2 is used, remove itemID of globalVar[sValue2]. If bValue2, XY specifies a travelpoint.

taskDescriptions.name: removeItem_g
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 'fValue' quantity of the item ID set in globalVar 'sValue' from the player's available inventory. Tries to remove from the stash, cargo, and any crew inventories until the quantity is fully removed.

taskDescriptions.name: removeItemFromFleetCargo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Remove 'fValue' quantity of 'sValue' itemType ID from the cargo of the fleet identified by 'sValue2'. sValue2 can be the ID of the commodore of the fleet, or the ID of a ship within the fleet, or the key word 'enemyFleet' or 'assistFleet' for fleets the player is currently in combat with. If fValue is 0, will remove 1. If fValue is -1 or less, removes all of sValue itemType. If sValue isn't set or is blank, 'fValue' quantity of all items are removed.

taskDescriptions.name: removeItemFromLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 'sValue' as the ID of an itemType or actorType from the stash, cargo or shipwright of a location. fValue is the quantity to remove, defaulting to 1. If fValue is negative, removes all. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. 'sValue' can be a key word to remove everything of a type: removeAllStash, removeAllCargo, removeAllShips

taskDescriptions.name: removeItemFromParty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 'fValue' quantity of item ID 'sValue' from the player's available inventory. Tries to remove from the stash, cargo, and any crew inventories until the quantity is fully removed.

taskDescriptions.name: removeItemOfValue
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Deletes items at X,Y of value fValue or greater.

taskDescriptions.name: removeitems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: removes all items (or all items of the ID specified in sValue) from the zone.

taskDescriptions.name: removeItemsNearPlayerActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Deletes items of type sValue1 within fValue tiles of player Actor.

taskDescriptions.name: removeJournalGoal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the first journal goal that matches the string in 'sValue' from the list of journal 'goal' gvars, then reassigns all 'goal' gVars to be in order with no gaps. If sValue is blank, just reassigns journal goals. The journal goal gVars will be stripped of spaces and special chars when checked against sValue. The check will be done in a case-insensitive manner.

taskDescriptions.name: removeLocationTag
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the 'sValue' tag from a location's tags list. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If sValue is not set, or is blank, all tags will be removed.

taskDescriptions.name: removeSpawnDataFromLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes all entries from a location's auto_spawnDataID list that match 'sValue'. If sValue isn't set, or is blank, every entry is removed. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: removeTalker
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) from the zone.

taskDescriptions.name: removeTempPartyActors
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes all actors from the zone that are in the player's current partyActors and have canControlFullyIfControllable = false.

taskDescriptions.name: removeTrigger
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes trigger of aliasID 'sValue' from the current zone.

taskDescriptions.name: removeUnlockableItemFromLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes an item from a location's itemType_quantity_unlockable list that matches an ID, formula and quantity, set in sValue as 'ID, formula' and fValue as quantity. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If any property to check isn't set, it will match all of that property (eg, fValue = 0 will match any quantity).

taskDescriptions.name: removeZoneBackgroundTex
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes texture 'sValue' from the list of background textures for the current zone, if it exists. If b1, removes all background textures.

taskDescriptions.name: removeZoneFX
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes recurring FX 'sValue' from the zone. If bValue1, removes all instances of that FX.

taskDescriptions.name: renameShip
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Shows the charEdit window for the last ship in the player's fleet.

taskDescriptions.name: repairAllStashItems
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets broken = false for every item in the player's stash inventory.

taskDescriptions.name: repairFleet_free
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Repairs all ships in the player's fleet, for free.

taskDescriptions.name: repairFleet_pay
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Repairs all ships in the player's fleet and removes the repair cost from their gold.

taskDescriptions.name: replaceEquipment
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Equips item 'sValue2' to actor 'sValue'. If fValue is specified, replaces that slot. Otherwise replaces the 1st relevant slot (0 for wpns, etc.)

taskDescriptions.name: replaceTriggerWithZoneSeries
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Replaces this trigger with a zone loaded from sValue ID + the value of sValue gVar. sValue2 specifies the levelData to use for replacing terrain when applying terrain replacer items.

taskDescriptions.name: res
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes the game window's size to 1920x959, which is the highest resolution before the screen scale changes.

taskDescriptions.name: research_report
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets 'sValue' dialogNode's statements based on journalEntries that have yet to be sold to a researcher.

taskDescriptions.name: researchFromFleet_slot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the ship in slot 'fValue' of the player's fleet and adds it as an unlockable ship for the current location. Also removes the ship actorType's value from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: resetachievements
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets all Horizon's Gate achievements for the current player's Steam account.

taskDescriptions.name: resetAllTileReactTimers
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the lastTimeReacted and delayTime to 0 for every tile in the current zone.

taskDescriptions.name: resetFleetAI
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets the current travel path for every AI fleet.

taskDescriptions.name: resetfog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: sets entire zone's fog of war to unknown

taskDescriptions.name: resetlocation
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets location ID 'sValue' or all ports/locations to their default data if not specified.

taskDescriptions.name: resetlocations
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Resets all ports/locations to their default data.

taskDescriptions.name: resetLocations
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: clears all data about the specified Location and reloads them from defaultLocations.txt (ex: resetloc port1)

taskDescriptions.name: resetPCDialogWindowSizeY
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the player's dialog window height to default (200).

taskDescriptions.name: resetprocgen
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Recreates all procedurally generated groves in the overworld.

taskDescriptions.name: resetwaypoints
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: re-initializes waypoints for the current zone.

taskDescriptions.name: resize
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Changes the game window's size to floats[0] pixels by floats[1] pixels.

taskDescriptions.name: retro
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles Retro Visuals mode

taskDescriptions.name: returnMissingPartyMembers
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds any partyActors that fell off of a cliff or drowned back to the player's current party.

taskDescriptions.name: returnPath
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Travel trigger that is set by 'travel_setReturnPath'.

taskDescriptions.name: revive
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Revives triggering actor, or actor 'sValue', by fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: reviveall
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Revives all incapacitated actors in the current zone except any actors whose ID is set in strings[], then fully heals them.

taskDescriptions.name: royalJobDialogOptions
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the dialogNode ID 'sValue' and its dialogOptions for the current royal quest, set in globalVar 'royalQuestType'.

taskDescriptions.name: safe
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: When in this trigger, ZoneManager.I.safe is true. Safe is used by the AI.

taskDescriptions.name: sanitizecheck
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: shows what the provided string would look like when formatted for formula checks.

taskDescriptions.name: sanitizeGlobalVar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes all characters that appear in sValue2 from the gVar set in sValue. If b1, only KEEPS characters that appear in sValue2 instead. Comparisons are case-insensitive. If sValue2 is blank or unset, runs the standard sanitize on it (spaces, periods, commas, math operators and colons), which also sets it to all lower case.

taskDescriptions.name: save
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Saves to Globals.AUTOSAVE_NAME, and notifies player. Saves to slot sValue if specified (or unused variant if save sValue already exists).

taskDescriptions.name: scaleCameraTo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets camera target scale to fValue, scaling at speed X/10. If speed=0 or less, sets scale instantly.

taskDescriptions.name: scaleSpecialZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Scale specialZone to sValue scale at fValue speed.

taskDescriptions.name: scoreScreen
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Brings up score screen, converts consumables into cash.

taskDescriptions.name: scoreScreenResponse
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: screenDarkWaveEffect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets zone's darkness wave frequency to fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: screenpic
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: displays screenshot forever. Can be given X Y to specify TC to screenshot at. Can be given a palette to paletteOverride the result. (ex: screenpic 20 20 p62)

taskDescriptions.name: screenscale
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the forcedScreenScale game option to 'fValue'. Set it to -1 to disable it.

taskDescriptions.name: screenshot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: saves a .png on desktop of the screen. Can be given X Y to specify TC to screenshot at. Can be given a palette to paletteOverride the result. (ex: screenshot 20 20 p62)

taskDescriptions.name: screenWaveEffect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets zone wave frequency to fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: script
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Executes sValue.lua.

taskDescriptions.name: sendAISignal
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sends signal 'sValue' to all actors within 'fValue' of X,Y (or triggering actor pos, or camera).

taskDescriptions.name: set
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: sets a global variable to # (ex: set rescuedShroom 1)

taskDescriptions.name: setActor_partSpritesThatTakePriorityOverClass
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's partSpritesThatTakePriorityOverClass to 'sValue2' (ex: 'torso, armR, shoulderR')

taskDescriptions.name: setActorAI
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's lua ai script to 'sValue2'. If bValue1, run the ai script once.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorAIActions
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's queuedAiActions to 'sValue2' (ex: action1, action2, ...).

taskDescriptions.name: setActorArmorPalette
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's armorPalette to 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is set to 'defaultPalette', actorType.armorPalette is used. If sValue2 is 'currentArmorPalette', the equipped armor palette is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorBodyPartSprite
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the sprite for actor 'sValue's bodyPart set in 'sValue2'. sValue2 needs to be in the format 'bodyPartID, spriteSheet'. If the 'spriteSheet' part of sValue2 is 'defaultSprite', actorType.defaultBodyPartSprites for the bodyPart is used. If it is 'randomSprite', a random sprite for the bodyPart from actorType.bodyPartSprites is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorBool
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's bool property 'sValue2' to bValue1.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorClothPalette
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's clothPalette to 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is 'defaultPalette', actorType.clothPalette is used. If sValue2 is 'randomPalette', a random selectable player palette is chosen. If sValue2 is 'playerPalette', the player's current clothPalette is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorCombatLabel
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's combatLabel to 'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorCombatLabel_color
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's combatLabel_color to 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is 'enemyFleet', 'playerFleet', 'assistFleet' or 'assistFleet_hostile', that set global Color is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorCombatMusicOverride
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's combatMusicOverride to 'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorCombatTeam
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's combatTeam to 'sValue2'. If 'sValue2' is 'defaultCombatTeam', actorType.defaultCombatTeam is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorDialogNodeID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's dialogNodeID to  'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorFaction
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's faction to 'sValue2'. If 'sValue2' is 'defaultFaction', actorType.defaultFaction is used. Can't change to/from 'player' faction.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorFloat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's float property 'sValue2' to 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's ID to 'sValue2'. If bValue1 is true, forces a unique ID based on sValue2. Cant change an ID to/from 'player'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorIdleAnimOverride
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's idleAnimOverride to  'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorMovementType
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's movementType to 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is set to 'defaultMovementType', actorType.movementType is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorName
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's name to 'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorPalettes
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's palettes to 'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorSkinPalette
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's skinPalette to 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is 'defaultPalette', actorType.skinPalette is used. If sValue2 is 'randomPalette', a random palette from actorType.skinPalettes is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorSprite
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's sprite to 'sValue2'. If 'sValue2' is 'defaultSprite', actorType.defaultSprite is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setActorUnarmoredPalette
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets actor 'sValue's unarmoredPalette to 'sValue2'. Updates armorPalette if no armor is equipped.

taskDescriptions.name: setAI_idle
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the ai_lua script for the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 'idle'.

taskDescriptions.name: setAI_idle_flag
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the ai_lua script for the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 'idle_flag'.

taskDescriptions.name: setAsDialogNode
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the dialogNodeID for the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 'sValue', or the currentDialogNode if unset.

taskDescriptions.name: setBP
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: set [BodyStructure]'s [BodyPart] origin position to [X][Y]. (ex: setBP human armL 3 4

taskDescriptions.name: setBPC
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: set [BodyStructure]'s [BodyPart] connection position, of the player actor's facingRot, to [X][Y]. (ex: setBPC human armL 3 4

taskDescriptions.name: setBuyPriceMult
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets Globals.buyPriceMult to 'fValue'. Item prices are multiplied by this. Reset to 1 before and after dialog mode.

taskDescriptions.name: setCombatUIVisible
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the turn order window and combat commands window visibility to bValue1. Also hides quickslots and character stats windows if bValue1 is false.

taskDescriptions.name: setCurrentActor_partSpritesThatTakePriorityOverClass
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets 'partSpritesThatTakePriorityOverClass' of the current player leader to sValue1 (ex: 'torso, armR, shoulderR')

taskDescriptions.name: setDefaultNodeIf
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the dialogNodeID for the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 'sValue' if the formula in 'svalue2' passes.

taskDescriptions.name: setDialogSpeed
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the dialogSpeedMult game option to 'fValue'.
