taskDescriptions.name: setDialogWindowSizeYAuto
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the dialog window height based on the text in the current dialogNode statements text if it overflows the default height.

taskDescriptions.name: setFaceSprite
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the 'face' bodyPart sprite for the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) to 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setFactionAI
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets AI script of all actors of 'sValue' faction to 'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setFactionHostile
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets all actors of 'sValue' faction to hostile if fValue =1+. Otherwise sets faction nonhostile. If xValue != -1, clears dialogNode.

taskDescriptions.name: setFog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the fogOfWar known state of all tiles in a square radius of 'fValue' from X,Y to bValue1.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar sValue to fValue (or sValue2 if specified).

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_math
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar sValue to Formula in sValue2. Decimals will be truncated. If b1, decimals won't be truncated.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorAugmentItemTypeInArmor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of the augmented item in slot 'fValue' of the armor of the actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is unset, tries to use the actorID of the current task. The gVar will be blank if no item is found in the armor augment slot.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorAugmentItemTypeInMainWeapon
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of the augmented item in slot 'fValue' of the main hand weapon of the actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is unset, tries to use the actorID of the current task. The gVar will be blank if no item is found in the main hand weapon augment slot.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorAugmentItemTypeInOffhandWeapon
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of the augmented item in slot 'fValue' of the offhand weapon of the actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is unset, tries to use the actorID of the current task. The gVar will be blank if no item is found in the offhand weapon augment slot.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorClassID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the actorClass ID in slot 'fValue' (0 = primary, 1 = secondary, 2 = third, 3 = fourth) of the actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is blank or not set, will try to use the current Task actorID.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar sValue to ID of the Actor that executed the trigger.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorItemTypeInSlot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of the item in slot 'fValue' of the inventory of the actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is unset, tries to use the actorID of the current task. The gVar will be blank if no item is found in the slot.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorMostUsedActionID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the gVar in sValue to the action ID of the 'fValue'-th most-used action of the player actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. fValue = 0 would be most used, 1 would be second most used, etc. If b1, only selects actions that are part of an actor class. If b2, only selects actions NOT part of an actor class.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorSupportAbilityID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the currently equipped supportAbility ID in slot 'fValue' (0, 1 or 2) of the actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is blank or not set, will try to use the current Task actorID.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toActorTypeID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the actorTypeID of the actor whose ID is 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is blank or not set, will try to use the current Task actorID.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toClassIDThatHasActionID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the 'fValue'-th (starting at 0) actorClass ID that has an action whose ID is 'sValue2' in its actions list.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toClassIDThatHasSupportAbilityID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the 'fValue'-th (starting at 0) actorClass ID that has a supportAbility whose ID is 'sValue2' in its supportAbilities list.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toCrewActorID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the ID of the crew Actor in the 'fValue'-th slot (starting at 0) of the ship Actor specified in 'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toFleetCargoItemIDSlot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of the item in slot 'fValue' of the cargo belonging to the fleet identified by 'sValue2'. sValue2 can be the ID of the commodore of the fleet, or the ID of a ship within the fleet, or the key word 'enemyFleet' or 'assistFleet' for fleets the player is currently in combat with.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toFleetCommodoreID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the ID of the commodore of the fleet identified by 'sValue2'. sValue2 should be the ID of a ship within the fleet, or the key word 'enemyFleet' or 'assistFleet' for fleets the player is currently in combat with. If the fleet doesn't have a commodore, the gVar is set to a blank string.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toFleetShipID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the ship actor ID in slot 'fValue' of the fleet identified by 'sValue2'. sValue2 can be the ID of the commodore of the fleet, or the ID of a ship within the fleet, or the key word 'enemyFleet' or 'assistFleet' for fleets the player is currently in combat with.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toItemTypeIDAtTile
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of the first non-invisible item found at tile X,Y with a quantity more than or equal to 'fValue' (defaults to 1 if 0). If 'sValue2' is set, it should be a 'property,value' that the item's itemType property needs to also match. If b1, 'property,value' needs to NOT match. If b2, will only match invisible itemTypes instead.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toItemTypeIDAtTileWithSpecialProp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of the first item found at tile X,Y with a quantity more than or equal to 'fValue' (defaults to 1 if 0) that has all specialPropertys set in 'sValue2' as a 'comma,separated,list'. An example sValue2 would be 'sprite2xWidth,cannotBePickedUp,animated'. If b1, sValue2 is the list of specialPropertys the itemType must NOT have any of.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toJournalGoalVar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the gVar name for the first journal 'goal#' gVar that matches 'sValue2', or a blank string if that journal goal doesn't exist. If b1, will set the gVar in sValue to the 'goal#Done' gVar name instead. The journal goal gVars will be stripped of spaces and special chars when checked against sValue2. The check will be done in a case-insensitive manner.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toJournalNote
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the 'fValue'-th (starting at 0) journal Notes entry string.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toLocationCargoItemIDSlot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of a cargo item in slot 'fValue' of a location's cargo inventory. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If there is no item in the slot specified or the location hasn't been visited yet, an empty string is set.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toLocationFactionID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the currently favored faction ID of a location. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. Sets an empty string if the location is neutral or not a port.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toLocationShipIDSlot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the actorType ID of a ship in slot 'fValue' of a location's shipwright_boatTypes list. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If there is no item in the slot specified, an empty string is set.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toLocationStashItemIDSlot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemType ID of a stash item in slot 'fValue' of a location's item inventory. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If there is no item in the slot specified or the location hasn't been visited yet, an empty string is set.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toNearestLocID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the nearest discoverable non-port location's ID within fValue radius of X,Y in the overworld zone set in sValue2 (defaults to eral if not set) to the gVar set in sValue. If X,Y is unset, will use player's X,Y. You can specify tags the location needs to contain in comma,separated,values after the overworld in sValue2 (eg, sValue2 = eral,grove). If b1, will also check locations that can't be discovered. If b2, locations must NOT have any of the tags set.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toNearestPortID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the nearest discoverable port location's ID within fValue radius of X,Y in the overworld zone set in sValue2 (defaults to eral if not set) to the gVar set in sValue. If X,Y is unset, will use player's X,Y. You can specify tags the location needs to contain in comma,separated,values after the overworld in sValue2 (eg, sValue2 = eral,hidden). If b1, will also check locations that can't be discovered. If b2, locations must NOT have any of the tags set.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toNearestRandomLocID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a random discoverable non-port location's ID that is within fValue radius of X,Y and in the overworld zone set in sValue2 (defaults to eral if not set) to the gVar set in sValue. If X,Y is unset, will use player's X,Y. You can specify tags the location needs to contain in comma,separated,values after the overworld in sValue2 (eg, sValue2 = eral,grove). If b1, will also check locations that can't be discovered. If b2, locations must NOT have any of the tags set.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toNearestRandomPortID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a random discoverable port location's ID that is within fValue radius of X,Y and in the overworld zone set in sValue2 (defaults to eral if not set) to the gVar set in sValue. If X,Y is unset, will use player's X,Y. You can specify tags the location needs to contain in comma,separated,values after the overworld in sValue2 (eg, sValue2 = eral,hidden). If b1, will also check locations that can't be discovered. If b2, locations must NOT have any of the tags set.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toOtherGlobalVar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar sValue to globalVar sValue2.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toPartyActorID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar sValue to ID of partyActor[fValue].

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toPartyActorTypeID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the actorTypeID of the current player party actor in slot 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toRandomActorTypeName
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a random name from the randomNames property of the actorType with the ID set in 'sValue2'. If sValue2 is blank or not set, will try to use the current Task actorID's actorTypeID.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toTriggerAliasID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the aliasID of the trigger in the current zone that has 'fValue' as its numID. If fValue is negative, sets gVar to the currently executing trigger aliasID, if there is one. Sets a blank string if the trigger doesn't have an aliasID set or isn't found.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toTriggerNumID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the numID of the trigger in the current zone that has an aliasID matching 'sValue2'. If fValue is negative or sValue2 is blank, sets gVar to the currently executing trigger numID, if there is one. Result is -1 if no triggers found.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVar_toTriggerNumIDSearch
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the numID of the 'fValue'-th (starting at 0) active trigger at X,Y, or the entire current zone if X,Y is not set, that matches a check set in 'sValue2'. If b1 is false, the check is for if the fReq of the trigger matches sValue2. If b1 is true, the check is for if the effectID in sValue2 is used in any trigger effect. If b2, only checks disabled triggers. Result is -1 if no triggers found.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarPlusLocID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the globalVar with the ID of 'sValue' + the current location's ID to 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarPlusLocID_math
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the globalVar with the ID of 'sValue' + the current location's ID to the result of the formula set in sValue2.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarPlusZoneID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the globalVar with the ID of 'sValue' + the current zone's ID to 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarTo_mouseOverWindow
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the ID of the window the mouse is currently hovering over, or a blank string if hovering over none.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarTo_mousePointingAt
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the itemTypeID of the item the player currently has their mouse over in the current zone. If b1, sets it to the Actor ID currently hovering over, if any. If b2, sets it to the terrainTypeID being hovered over. If b1 and b2, b1 takes priority. Sets a blank string if hovering over nothing.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarTo0
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar 'sValue' to 0.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToActionProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded acton's property, set in sValue2 as 'actionID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToActorClassProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded actorClass property, set in sValue2 as 'actorClassID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToActorProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to an actor's property, set in sValue2 as 'actorID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToActorTypeProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded actorType property, set in sValue2 as 'actorTypeID,property'. If 'actorTypeID' is the ID of an actor in the zone, their actorTypeID is used.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToFactionProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded faction's property, set in sValue2 as 'factionID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToItemTypeProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded itemType property, set in sValue2 as 'itemTypeID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToLocationProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded location property, set in sValue2 as 'locationID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToLocID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar 'sValue' to the ID of the current location. Doesn't get set if not in a location.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToPartyActorNum
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar 'sValue' to 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToPlayerFleetShipProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the gVar in sValue to the actor property specified in sValue2, of the player fleet's ship actor in slot fValue. If b1, the property is pulled from the actor's actorType instead of the actor.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToSupportAbilityProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded supportAbility property, set in sValue2 as 'supportAbilityID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToTalkerID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a dialog specialEffect. Sets the globalVar 'strings[0]' to the currentActorTalkingTo's ID.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToTerrainTypeProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to a loaded terrainType property, set in sValue2 as 'terrainTypeID,property'.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToTriggerProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets gVar 'sValue' to the property 'sValue2' of a trigger in the current zone whose numID is 'fValue'. If sValue2 is 'aliasID,property', then it will instead set the property from the global trigger whose 'aliasID' matches, even if fValue is set. If fValue is negative, gets the property from the currently executing trigger, if it exists. Result is an empty string if no trigger was found.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarToZoneProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar 'sValue' to the string representation of the current zone's property, set in sValue2.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarWithCommas
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets globalVar strings[0] to the remaining combined strings[] values, joined with commas between each.

taskDescriptions.name: setGlobalVarWithTalkerID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a dialog specialEffect. Sets globalVar 'sValue' + the currentActorTalkingTo's ID to the string set in sValue2, or 'fValue' if not set.

taskDescriptions.name: setJournalNote
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets journal Notes entry 'fValue' (starting at 0) to 'sValue' string.

taskDescriptions.name: setk
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: sets kill count to # (ex: set antiair 1)

taskDescriptions.name: setLocationLocation
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's zoneThisLocationIsIn to 'sValue' if specified. If X/Y aren't -1, sets the location's xy to them. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If sValue is blank, zoneThisLocationIsIn isn't changed. If X/Y are -1, xy isn't changed. Any locationItems will be moved to the new location with their same offsets.

taskDescriptions.name: setLocDiscoverable
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's discoverable bool to true. 'sValue' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If 'sValue2' is set, it will be the new formula for the location's discoverable_fReq. If b1 is set and the player is in zoneThisLocationIsIn, will set discovered to true and unbury the location.

taskDescriptions.name: setLocEnterable
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's enterable bool to b1. 'sValue' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: setLocMinimapIcon
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the minimapIcon of a location to 'sValue'. If a location's minimapIcon is not set, or is blank, and the location is a port, the icon of the faction controlling the port is used. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: setLocName
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's name to 'sValue'. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: setLocPort
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's port bool to b1. 'sValue' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: setLocTravelPoint
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's enterOnTravelPointNum to fValue. Defaults to 0 if negative. 'sValue' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead.

taskDescriptions.name: setLocUndiscoverable
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's discovered and discoverable bool to false. 'sValue' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If b1 is set, will set the location's discoverable_fReq formula to '1' (which is default).

taskDescriptions.name: setLocZoneID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets a location's zoneID to 'sValue'. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. Keep in mind that changing a location's zoneID while the player is in it might make it unable to be left, if unaccounted for.

taskDescriptions.name: setMainMenuUIVisible
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Sets the main menu visibility to b1. If b2, force-draws main menu BG and UIManager windows.

taskDescriptions.name: setMoney
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets current money to fValue, or formula sValue.

taskDescriptions.name: setNodeIDGlobalVar_1
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used in dialog. Sets the globalVar with the same ID as the currentDialogNodeID to 1.

taskDescriptions.name: setOnlyNPCDialogWindowSizeY
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the dialog window height to 'fValue'. If unset in a dialog specialEffect, or set to 0, sets the size to default (200).

taskDescriptions.name: setPartyActorAsVendor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Removes the party actor in slot floats[0] and places them on travelPoint floats[1], then switches their dialogNodeID to strings[0].

taskDescriptions.name: setPCDialogWindowSizeY
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the dialog options window height to 'fValue'. If unset in a dialog specialEffect, or set to 0, sets the size to default (200).

taskDescriptions.name: setPrevFacingRot
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the talkerPreviousFacingRot to the current rotation of the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog). If sValue is set, it should be the rotation to set it to instead. If sValue isn't set, but fValue is > 0, it will be set to that rotation instead (360 == 0). The talkerPreviousFacingRot is the rotation the currentActorTalkingTo will be set to once dialog finishes.

taskDescriptions.name: setRoofDrawNoMatterWhat
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets camera.drawRoofsNoMatterWhat to bValue1.

taskDescriptions.name: setSpecialInfoTC
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the specialInfoTC of any valid items that have the ID of 'sValue' (or all items if none set) at tile X,Y to a new specialInfoTC set in 'sValue2' as 'X,Y'. If b1, the specialInfoTC is offset by the X,Y rather than set to it. If b2, 'sValue' is a specialProperty to check for instead of ID.

taskDescriptions.name: setTerrainType_spriteOffsetModulo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the spriteXOffsetModulo and spriteYOffsetModulo of terrainType 'sValue' to X and Y.

taskDescriptions.name: setTerrainType_spriteOffsetMult
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the spriteXOffsetMult and spriteYOffsetMult of terrainType 'sValue' to X and Y.

taskDescriptions.name: setTerrainTypes_spriteOffsetModulo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the spriteXOffsetModulo and spriteYOffsetModulo of any terrainTypes whose ID starts with 'sValue', to X and Y.

taskDescriptions.name: setTileTerrain
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets tile at X,Y to 'sValue' terrainTypeID. If bValue1, shows terrain change FX.

taskDescriptions.name: setTileTerrainArea
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets tiles in a rectangle to 'sValue' terrainTypeID, starting at the top left of X,Y through to the bottom right set in sValue2 as 'X,Y'. fValue adds a delay between each tile change. If bValue1, shows terrain change FX. If bValue2, reverses order of tiles changed.

taskDescriptions.name: setupBuyShipDialog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the dialogOptions for dialogNode 'sValue' for purchasing ships from the current location, based on its set shipwright_boatTypes list.

taskDescriptions.name: setupCafeFoodDialogOptionsWealth100
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the dialogOptions for dialogNode 'sValue' used to set the current supply port's cafe food.

taskDescriptions.name: setupFleetLooting
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the current enemyFleet's cargo inventory to also contain any assist fleet cargo and any items left on player ships, for use with 'lootFleet_afterCombat' task after fleet combat.

taskDescriptions.name: setupGraveyard
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: setupLocationAsPlayerPort
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the current location as a player-owned port. This also adds ships, items, and spawnData to the location's lists.

taskDescriptions.name: setupPartyFromGVars
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Must be used as a taskString. Sets the player's current party to consist of actors with IDs specified in each strings[] entry as a globalVar, which could also be the slot number of the the actor in the current partyActors list. An example: setupPartyFromGVars,gVar1,gVar2,gVar3,aFourthGVar,andSoOn

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneBG
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Set zone BG; sValue = terrainType.

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneBGFX
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets zone bgFXID to 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneBoolProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the bool-type property of the current zone, specified in 'sValue', to the bool set by 'b1'.

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneDarknessToWorldDarkness
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the current zone's darknessColor based on the time of day. If b1, also change camera's darknessColor.

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneFloatProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the float-type property of the current zone, specified in 'sValue', to the float set in 'fValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: setZonePalettes
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets 'sValue' zone palette to 'sValue2'. If 'sValue' is blank, sets all palettes.

taskDescriptions.name: setZonePeaceful
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Set zone.peaceful true if bValue1. False otherwise.

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneRollingPinStyle
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the current zone's rollingPinStyle to bValue1.

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneSongs
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets zone travel song to 'sValue' &combat song to sValue2 at 'fValue' pitch. If X is set, volume = X/100. Y = combatSongDelay. If bValue1, force assign travelSong even if blank. Same for bValue2 & combat.

taskDescriptions.name: setZoneStringProperty
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the string-type property of the current zone, specified in 'sValue', to the string set in 'sValue2'.

taskDescriptions.name: sfx
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Play unlooped sound FX 'sValue' at volume 1, pitch 0.

taskDescriptions.name: showCharstats
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Unhides the character stats window, if it was hidden.

taskDescriptions.name: showEscFactionWindow
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Shows just the faction part of the escMenu and sets nextDialogNode_hideWindow = true.

taskDescriptions.name: showFleetInfo
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets up the dialogOptions for dialogNode 'sValue' for selecting ships to inspect when inspecting the fleet the currentActorTalkingTo belongs to.

taskDescriptions.name: showQuickslots
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Unhides character stats and quickslots.

taskDescriptions.name: sp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: show list of all saved setPieces. Returns results that start w/ given param. (ex: sp puzzle)

taskDescriptions.name: spawn
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Creates SpawnData 'sValue'. (Executes 'spawn_actorPrefab' instead if sValue matches an actorPrefab ID.) 'sValue2' is the groupID. Groups won't spawn if actors of groupID already exist. NOTE: group spawns in random spots IN TRIGGER AREA, unless X,Y specified. fValue = group power level mod. bValue1 = group face toward trigger area center.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_actorPrefab
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Creates actorPrefab 'sValue'at X,Y. 'sValue2' specifies an animation to use when spawning. fValue = facingRot. bValue1 = use actorPrefab ID exactly (instead of zone-specific actorID).

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_actorPrefab_point
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: As 'spawn_actorPrefab', except X specifies what travelPoint to use, and Y specifies which set of travelPoints to use (0 red, 1 blue, 2 green, 3 brown).

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_actorPrefab_point_specialZone
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: PROBABLY DO NOT USE. Adds a copy of actorPrefab 'sValue' to the current specialZone, on the xValue'th travelPoint of travelPoint set yValue.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_corpse
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Spawns a random corpse from partyActors_corpse either at XY or in the centermost occupiable tile in the trigger area.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_fleet
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Spawns a battle fleet in the current zone using spawnData 'sValue' at TC X,Y with the commodoreID set in sValue2. fValue sets the fleetPowerLevelMod. If b1, is a merchant fleet instead. If b2, is elite.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_g
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Same as 'spawn', but sValue is a globalVar to use as the spawnData.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_g_nearPlayer
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Same as 'spawn', but sValue is a globalVar to use as the spawnData, and the group is placed near the player. If b2, group is placed roughly 3 tiles behind the player.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_location
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Spawns actorPrefabs from the current location's auto_spawnDataID list, up the a maximum based on the current wealthLevel. Places them on the first unoccupied travelPoint set B item.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_onItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Creates SpawnData 'sValue' actors on items with 'sValue2' specialProperty. fValue = group power level mod. If bValue1, can spawn even if group is already extant. Actors look at XY if specified.

taskDescriptions.name: spawn_seamonster
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Spawns a sea monster using spawnData 'sValue'. fValue specifies the desiredPowerLevel. If sValue is an empty string, finds the closest monsterBeacon item and uses 'sm' + its quantity as the spawnData ID.

taskDescriptions.name: spawnItem
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Adds 'fValue' num of item 'sValue' ID to X,Y (or random spot in trigger area if unspecified) and plays 'sValue2' fx if specified. If sValue is not an item type, checks globalVar for an ID. If bValue1, force item to fit. If bValue2, XY refers to a travelpoint (#X, set Y).

taskDescriptions.name: specialKeyStatusUpdate
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: specialSpawn
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Applies specialSpawn 'sValue' to the zone.

taskDescriptions.name: speechFX
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Plays the set fxSpeech FX for the actorType of the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: startCombatAIActing
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Technically does nothing.

taskDescriptions.name: stealloc
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Converts all port locations in the overworld that can be converted to the player's current faction, as set in globalVar 'playerFaction'.

taskDescriptions.name: stopCombatAIActing
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: If in combat and it's not a player actor's turn, this ends the current AI actor's turn and resets its calculated action plan.

taskDescriptions.name: storeBoost
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets playerActor_storedBoost to true, which will reapply the speed boost the player's ship may have had before being interrupted by a dialog.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract10000gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 10,000 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract1000gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 1,000 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract100gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 100 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract10gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 10 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract130gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 130 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract150gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 150 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract200gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 200 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract20gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 20 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract250gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 250 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract300gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 300 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract30gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 30 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract350gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 350 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract400gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 400 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract40gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 40 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract5000gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 5,000 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract500gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 500 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract50gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 50 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract60gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 60 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract75gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 75 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtract800gp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Subtracts 800 from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtractAllgp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the player's gold to 0.

taskDescriptions.name: subtractBribeAmount
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Subtracts the bribe amount used for auto dialog from the player's gold.

taskDescriptions.name: subtractgp
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes 'fValue' gold from the player. If 'sValue' is set, it should be a formula, with the result of that formula being the amount to remove.

taskDescriptions.name: swapIconForLocationID
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Changes an icon from a location's tooltipIcons list to another icon, specified in sValue as 'oldIcon, newIcon'. 'sValue2' is the ID of the location. If ID is not set, uses current location instead. If b1, 'newIcon' will be added to list even if 'oldIcon' doesn't exist.

taskDescriptions.name: talk
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enter dialog with actor 'sValue'. 'sValue2' specifies dialogNode if assigned. If bValue1, dialog is centered on speaker. If bValue2, makes dialog fullscreen.

taskDescriptions.name: talkToCommodore
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enter dialog with the commodore of the fleet the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) is part of, using the currentDialogNodeID.

taskDescriptions.name: talkToFirstMate
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enter dialog with the actor ID set in globalVar 'firstmate', using the currentDialogNodeID.

taskDescriptions.name: talkToFlagship
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enter dialog with the actor that is the flagship of the fleet the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog) is part of.

taskDescriptions.name: talkToOtherActor
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Enters dialog with the other actor that is currently on the same tile as the currentActorTalkingTo (or current task actor if not in dialog).

taskDescriptions.name: task
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: execute a task set as a comma-separated string in 'sValue'

taskDescriptions.name: task_gvar
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: execute a comma-separated task as defined by global variable 'sValue'

taskDescriptions.name: tc
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles being able to enter combat

taskDescriptions.name: tcui
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles combat ui

taskDescriptions.name: tdm
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles damage numbers

taskDescriptions.name: test
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: testboatanim
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: testitemload
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: puts 1 item on every tile. Default ID: toyboat.

taskDescriptions.name: testskillcost
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: testzones
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Travels to all, or floats[1] number of zones found in the ZoneData folder floats[0] times, with a delay of 1.5 seconds per zone change.

taskDescriptions.name: textOverlay
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets sValue as overlaid text. If sValue = '', clears overlaid text. fValue (0-255) is the alpha of the black behind the overlay. xValue & yValue offset the text. If bValue1, centers text Xpos. Bvalue2, Ypos.

taskDescriptions.name: textOverlay_dynamic
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Same as 'textOverlay', except reveals text dynamically.

taskDescriptions.name: textOverlay_tween
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Tweens in sValue as overlaid text. If sValue = '', tweens out. fValue (0-255) is the alpha of the black behind the overlay. xValue & yValue offset the text.

taskDescriptions.name: tfl
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles 60 fps limit

taskDescriptions.name: time
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: advance world time by # hours (does not consume food or affect morale).

taskDescriptions.name: timeSpeed
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Sets the game speed to fValue.

taskDescriptions.name: tm
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles menus & many other elements

taskDescriptions.name: tMapTest
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: togglePause
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Toggles pause of all actors and actions.

taskDescriptions.name: tq
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles quickslots & charstats

taskDescriptions.name: travel
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Travel-friendly trigger moves party to 'sValue' zone at X,Y. fValue = party facingRot. Autosaves unless bValue1=true

taskDescriptions.name: travel_g
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Travel to the zone name stored in globalVar 'lastProcZoneEntry'.

taskDescriptions.name: travel_gVars
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Travel to zone gVar 'playerPrevZone' at XY 'playerX', 'playerY'. fValue = facingRot.

taskDescriptions.name: travel_leaveLocation
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Moves party to where the current Location is. IMPORTANT: XY determines pos offset from that Location. If !bValue1, XY of -1,-1 is treated as 0,0.

taskDescriptions.name: travel_noSave
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Use 'travel' task instead.

taskDescriptions.name: travel_point
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Travel-friendly trigger moves party to 'sValue' zone at point fValue. If bValue1, don't autosave. If bValue2, acts as if entered via console (doesn't roll loot tables, etc).

taskDescriptions.name: travel_point_g
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: As travel_point, but goes to zoneID of globalVar 'sValue'.

taskDescriptions.name: travel_procedural
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Travel-friendly trigger moves party to new procedural world made from levelData 'sValue', which leads to 'sValue2'. If bValue1, there is no way back. If XY set a specific returnXY. bValue2 uses trigger area as returnXY. If sValue2 matches a globalTriggerID the exit executes that trigger instead of a travel trigger. If sValue2 has 2 values (EX: z1, z2) the 2nd one is the zone entered from.

taskDescriptions.name: travel_procedural_point
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: As 'travel_procedural', but fValue specifies a travelPoint to place the party on.

taskDescriptions.name: travel_setReturnPath
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Like 'travel', but sets the closest 'returnPath' trigger in the next zone to go back to this zone. If bValue, sets returnTC to the btm mid of the trigger area.

taskDescriptions.name: trigger
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Executes trigger of sValue aliasID (including globalTriggers), or of IDnum fValue. sValue2 is an additional fReq. If bValue1, then execute regardless of the trigger's fReq/Once-only. If bValue2, can't rerun a Once-Only trigger.

taskDescriptions.name: triggerEffect
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE.

taskDescriptions.name: tryDialog
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Checks for any dialogOverrides for nodeID sValue.

taskDescriptions.name: tryDialog_commodore
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: DO NOT USE. Used specifically for dialog with an enemyFleet during fleet combat.

taskDescriptions.name: trySetAchievement
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Attempts to set Steam achievement sValue.

taskDescriptions.name: tt
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles tooltips

taskDescriptions.name: tw
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: toggles wires

taskDescriptions.name: UIPartInputCommand
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Calls handleUIPartInput_command(string0, string1, float0, string2, float1)

taskDescriptions.name: unlearnJournalEntry
taskDescriptions.officialDescription: Removes the journalEntry ID in sValue from the known journals and reported journals list. If b1, doesn't remove from reported journal list.
